I help individuals and organisations specify useful research questions and develop credible ways to answer them.

That can mean working at the start of a project—clarifying the problem, exploring concepts, identifying outcomes, and selecting a study design—or joining later to support analysis, modelling, interpretation, or synthesis of an existing evidence base.

## How I can help

- Framing and refining research questions
- Conceptual development and outcome selection
- Study and evaluation design
- Statistical analysis and modelling
- Evidence review and synthesis
- Interpretation and communication of findings
- Independent methodological review

My experience covers academic, public-sector, and private-sector projects across exercise, physical activity, sport, health, and adjacent fields. If a project needs expertise outside my own, I can often identify an appropriate person or resource through my network and refer you onto them for support.

## Start a conversation

Email [james@steele-research.com](mailto:james@steele-research.com) with a short outline of the question or project. I will reply to arrange an initial conversation about the need, scope, and likely cost.
